Bhai, mere dhan ke patte mud rahe hain, kya karu?

Bhai, ek saaf photo bhejiye — patte ke upar aur neeche dono side, aur paudhe ka poora hissa. Aksar wajah paani/nutrient, keede, ya fungal bimari hoti hai; photo ke bina pakka nahi bata sakta. Tab tak: 1) affected patte/phool hata kar khet se door dispose karein, 2) paani subah dein taaki patte sookh jayein, 3) paudhon ke beech hawa aane dein aur khet mein paani jama na hone dein, 4) sticky trap/neem oil jaise safe IPM steps label ke instructions ke hisaab se try karein. Koi bhi pesticide bina label ya KVK/agriculture officer ki salah ke na chhidkein. Sahi wajah ke liye nazdiki KVK ya agri officer se sample dikhayein.

Healthcare mein AI use karne ke pros and cons batao, aur phir analysis ke base pe ek conclusion do.

Pro: Healthcare mein AI diagnostics ko improve kar sakta ha, bimariyon ka jaldi pata chal jayega or treatment plans better ho jayenge. Isse efficiency badhegi aur patients ko zyada fayda hoga. Con: AI se patient data ki privacy khatre mein pad sakti hai aur ethical issues bhi aa sakte hain, jaise ki algorithms mein bias hona. Conclusion: AI healthcare ko puri tarah badal sakta hai, par data privacy aur ethical problems ko solve karna zaroori hai taaki iska use fair aur responsible tareeke se ho sake.

Ye statement true hai ya false: Artificial intelligence saari human jobs le sakta hai.

False.
